scope: Independent quantitative-response study holdout using Replogle 2022 K562/RPE1 as out-of-domain tests. This is not independent primary-T validation.
training: Only GWT raw-QC responses from CE0008162 and CE0006864, all three T conditions, on the same metadata-only matched target/gene intersection as E3
validation: CE0010866 T donor, selection/calibration target hash as frozen
excluded: CE0008678 T donor responses; every K562/RPE1 perturbation-response label from training, transforms, selection and calibration
test: All matched K562 and RPE1 target responses
permission: P1 direct inputs: target function annotations and external non-targeting controls allowed; no direct same-target response vector or pretrained numeric teacher
control_encoding: Same fixed control projection and literal-context hash as E3, trained normalization only on the two training T donors
limitations: target selection conditional on matched coverage
Reactome annotation references have not been individually traced to exclude literature knowledge from the held study
no formal conformal exchangeability guarantee across studies
